headline: Daily AI Utility Hub: Practical Automation & Productivity Insights
intro: A curated selection of actionable AI workflows, tools, and operational strategies to enhance daily efficiency.
ideas: Automating inbox triage and prioritization using customized classification prompts.
Extracting key data points from lengthy PDF contracts into structured tables.

Creating modular response templates for common customer service inquiries.

tips: Provide explicit constraints and output formats in prompts to minimize revision rounds.
Double-check critical facts and figures against primary sources to ensure factual accuracy.
Start new conversation threads for distinct topics to avoid context drift.
